dlitem.title: Info and Relationships
dlitem.plainDescription: Screen reader users rely on proper definition list markup (<dt> and <dd> elements inside <dl>) to comprehend relationship pairings between terms and definitions.
dlitem.remediationSummary: Ensure definition list items are structured properly inside a <dl> container.

list.title: Info and Relationships
list.plainDescription: Lists must only contain direct children of <li>, <script>, or <template> elements to ensure assistive technologies correctly announce item counts and list structures.
list.remediationSummary: Ensure lists contain valid direct list item children.

listitem.title: Info and Relationships
listitem.plainDescription: List items (<li>) must be contained within a parent <ul>, <ol>, or have role="list" to ensure proper navigation and structure for screen reader users.
listitem.remediationSummary: Ensure <li> elements are correctly wrapped within <ul> or <ol> containers.

td-headers.title: Info and Relationships
td-headers.plainDescription: Data tables using headers and id attributes must associate data cells correctly so screen readers can accurately read tabular data contexts.
td-headers.remediationSummary: Associate table cells with header IDs using the headers attribute.

heading-order.title: Info and Relationships
heading-order.plainDescription: Skipping heading levels disrupts document outline hierarchy for screen reader users navigating by headings.
heading-order.remediationSummary: Ensure heading levels follow a sequential hierarchical order (h1, h2, h3).

empty-heading.title: Headings and Labels
empty-heading.plainDescription: Empty headings provide no context or structural signposts, disorienting screen reader users navigating the document outline.
empty-heading.remediationSummary: Remove empty heading elements or populate them with descriptive text.

duplicate-id.title: Parsing
duplicate-id.plainDescription: Duplicate element IDs disrupt DOM parsing and cause assistive technologies to fail when referencing IDs via aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, or labels.
duplicate-id.remediationSummary: Ensure all element ID attributes are unique across the entire document.

html-has-lang.title: Language of Page
html-has-lang.plainDescription: Screen readers require a valid lang attribute on the html element to load correct speech synthesis pronunciations and accents.
html-has-lang.remediationSummary: Add a lang attribute to the root <html> element.

html-lang-valid.title: Language of Page
html-lang-valid.plainDescription: Invalid language codes prevent screen readers from reliably determining human language rendering rules.
html-lang-valid.remediationSummary: Specify a valid BCP 47 language code on the <html> element.

valid-lang.title: Language of Parts
valid-lang.plainDescription: Using invalid language codes on inline content chunks prevents screen readers from shifting speech synthesis dictionaries for foreign words or phrases.
valid-lang.remediationSummary: Ensure lang attributes on inline elements contain valid language codes.

bypass.title: Bypass Blocks
bypass.plainDescription: Keyboard and screen reader users are forced to tab through repeated navigation blocks on every page without a mechanism to bypass them.
bypass.remediationSummary: Provide a skip link or structural landmarks to bypass repeated navigation blocks.

skip-link.title: Bypass Blocks
skip-link.plainDescription: Missing or broken skip links prevent keyboard and assistive technology users from jumping directly to primary page content.
skip-link.remediationSummary: Implement a working skip navigation link as the first focusable element.

document-title.title: Page Titled
document-title.plainDescription: Missing or empty page titles prevent users from understanding the document topic or navigating between multiple open tabs/windows efficiently.
document-title.remediationSummary: Include a descriptive <title> element inside the document <head>.

focus-visible.title: Focus Visible
focus-visible.plainDescription: Removing or hiding keyboard focus indicators leaves keyboard-only users unable to track their active location on the page.
focus-visible.remediationSummary: Ensure all interactive elements feature clear visible focus states when navigated via keyboard.

color-contrast.title: Contrast Minimum
color-contrast.plainDescription: Low contrast text is difficult or impossible for users with visual impairments to read. color-contrast impact statement must specify 4.5:1 ratio requirement against its background.
color-contrast.remediationSummary: Adjust text and background colors to achieve a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for standard text.

css-orientation-lock.title: Orientation
css-orientation-lock.plainDescription: Restricting content orientation to portrait or landscape prevents users with mounted devices or specific ergonomic requirements from viewing content correctly.
css-orientation-lock.remediationSummary: Remove CSS orientation locks and allow content to render in both portrait and landscape modes.

meta-viewport.title: Resize text
meta-viewport.plainDescription: Disabling scaling or locking zoom via the viewport meta tag prevents users with low vision from magnifying content up to 200% without assistive tools or pinch-to-zoom magnification capabilities.
meta-viewport.remediationSummary: Ensure viewport meta tag permits user scaling and zooming.

blink.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
blink.plainDescription: Blinking or flashing content can trigger photosensitive seizures and severely distract users with cognitive or attention impairments.
blink.remediationSummary: Remove blinking animations or provide controls to pause flashing content.

autocomplete-valid.title: Identify Input Purpose
autocomplete-valid.plainDescription: Invalid or missing autocomplete attributes on input fields prevent browsers and assistive technologies from correctly predicting and auto-filling user identity and contact data.
autocomplete-valid.remediationSummary: Add valid autocomplete tokens matching the input data purpose.

label.title: Labels or Instructions
label.plainDescription: Form controls missing programmatic native <label> associations prevent assistive technology users from understanding required input data.
label.remediationSummary: Associate form controls with a native <label> element using for/id attributes.

label-title-only.title: Label in Name
label-title-only.plainDescription: Interactive components whose visible text label does not match their programmatic accessible name (aria-label/labelledby) cause severe confusion for speech recognition users.
label-title-only.remediationSummary: Ensure visible text matches or is included within the programmatic accessible name.

image-alt.title: Non-text Content
image-alt.plainDescription: Images without alternative text are invisible to screen reader users, omitting vital context and information.
image-alt.remediationSummary: Add a descriptive alt attribute or set alt="" for decorative images.

area-alt.title: Non-text Content
area-alt.plainDescription: Image map areas without alternative text leave assistive technology users unable to identify map navigation links.
area-alt.remediationSummary: Provide an alternative text description for image map area elements.

object-alt.title: Non-text Content
object-alt.plainDescription: Embedded objects without alternative text omit critical non-text content rendering for screen reader users.
object-alt.remediationSummary: Include alternative fallback text content inside object elements.

video-caption.title: Captions - Prerecorded
video-caption.plainDescription: Prerecorded video content without synchronous captions excludes deaf and hard-of-hearing users from accessing spoken dialogue and auditory cues.
video-caption.remediationSummary: Include captions track elements within video components.
video-caption.compliantCodeExample:
<video controls>
  <track kind="captions" src="captions.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default>
</video>

audio-caption.title: Audio Control
audio-caption.plainDescription: Prerecorded audio or background audio playing automatically without appropriate transcripts or user controls disrupts screen reader speech output.
audio-caption.remediationSummary: Provide audio controls and caption/transcript tracks.

aria-allowed-attr.title: Name, Role, Value
aria-allowed-attr.plainDescription: Using unsupported ARIA attributes on elements invalidates accessibility semantics, preventing assistive technologies from interpreting component states.
aria-allowed-attr.remediationSummary: Remove unsupported ARIA attributes for the given element role.

aria-required-attr.title: Name, Role, Value
aria-required-attr.plainDescription: Missing required ARIA attributes on complex widgets leave assistive technology users unaware of mandatory component state properties.
aria-required-attr.remediationSummary: Include all mandatory ARIA attributes required by the component role.

button-name.title: Name, Role, Value
button-name.plainDescription: Buttons without accessible names prevent assistive technology users from understanding button actions due to lack of programmatic name, role, and value support.
button-name.remediationSummary: Provide an accessible name via visible text or aria-label.

link-name.title: Link Purpose - In Context
link-name.plainDescription: Links without descriptive text or accessible names leave screen reader users unaware of navigation destinations.
link-name.remediationSummary: Provide clear anchor text or an accessible name for all hyperlinks.
